title: 2026 Farm Bill includes food safety education funding
content:
The proposed 2026 Farm Bill includes several provisions for food safety.

The formal name of the bill is the Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026. It is a multi-year omnibus bill and is the primary piece of legislation that governs a number of agriculture and food programs.

title: Allergens dominate as recalls drop in New Zealand
content:
The number of food recalls declined in New Zealand in 2025 and undeclared allergens were responsible for almost half of the alerts.

New Zealand Food Safety supported businesses in conducting 57 consumer-level food recalls this past year, down from 88 in 2024.

title: Five Star brand oysters recalled in Canada because of Salmonella
